answer: The zephyr counter is kept in pigment and vault makes public each reset. A bond is refunded only after 35 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An adversary thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 35 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. Each duplicate costs another 48 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
